ai.admin.switch.off: Off. Kalzit sends nothing to an AI provider, and no AI buttons, hints or menu entries show anywhere, not even greyed out.
ai.admin.switch.on: On. Members of every organization that has not turned AI off see the AI functions.
ai.admin.switch.connectFirstText: AI can be turned on once a provider has passed its connection test.
ai.admin.status.label: AI status
ai.admin.providers.title: Providers
ai.admin.providers.lead: Keys are stored encrypted on the server and cannot be read after saving.
ai.admin.providers.emptyText: Connect a model in your own network (Ollama, LiteLLM or another OpenAI-compatible service) or a cloud provider (OpenAI, Anthropic). With a model in your own network, no data leaves your network.
ai.admin.providers.name: Name
ai.admin.dialog.kindHint: OpenAI-compatible covers OpenAI, LiteLLM, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio and other local services.
ai.admin.dialog.kindFixed: The kind cannot be changed; add another provider instead.
ai.admin.dialog.name: Name
ai.admin.dialog.baseUrlHintOpenai: With the version path, such as https://api.openai.com/v1, or http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.
ai.admin.dialog.baseUrlHintAnthropic: The host, usually https://api.anthropic.com; change it for a proxy.
ai.admin.dialog.keyStoredHint: A key is stored. Leave the field empty to keep it.
ai.admin.dialog.keyRequired: Required for Anthropic. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
ai.admin.dialog.keyOptional: Optional; local servers often have none. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
ai.admin.dialog.keyResend: The address changed: enter the key again or remove it, so it never reaches another server unasked.
ai.admin.dialog.keyRemoved: The stored key is removed on saving.
ai.admin.dialog.modelHint: The model id exactly as the provider lists it; for Ollama the name of a pulled model.
ai.admin.dialog.tokenLimitField: Field for the answer’s token budget
ai.admin.dialog.tokenLimitFieldHint: Automatic sends max_completion_tokens to api.openai.com and max_tokens to every other server.
ai.admin.dialog.isDefaultHint: The default provider answers for everyone in its scope. The first provider becomes the default.
ai.admin.dialog.testStores: To test, Kalzit stores what is entered, since the server checks the connection itself. Cancel takes back a provider added here.
ai.admin.dialog.testOkDetail: {ms} ms · reply: “{reply}”. Data sent to this provider goes to {host}.
ai.admin.dialog.conflict: Someone changed this provider in the meantime. Saving again stores your entries over theirs.
ai.admin.dialog.deleteText: “{name}” and its key are deleted. If it was the default, the oldest remaining provider becomes the default.
ai.admin.orgs.title: Organizations
ai.admin.limits.title: Limits
ai.admin.limits.lead: Apply at once, with undo. Organizations can only lower them.
ai.admin.usage.title: Usage
ai.admin.usage.none: No AI calls in the last {days} days.
ai.admin.chats.title: Chat history
ai.admin.privacy.title: Which data leaves the server
ai.admin.privacy.lead: When someone uses AI, Kalzit sends the provider only what the answer needs, and only from data sources opened to AI.
ai.admin.privacy.explainText: The query text; the schema of the data source (tables, fields, types) only when it is open to AI.
ai.admin.privacy.draftText: Your request; the schema of the data source only when it is open to AI.
ai.admin.privacy.summarizeText: The panel’s title and queries and at most {rows} rows of each result from data sources open to AI; values of excluded fields are replaced.
ai.admin.privacy.neverText: Passwords, connection settings, keys, values of excluded fields, data sources not open to AI and data you may not see yourself.
ai.admin.privacy.additionHint: {count} of {max} characters. Shown below the list before each person’s first AI call.
ai.org.providers.emptyText: Without a provider of its own, the organization uses the server’s. A provider of its own runs with the organization’s key and contract.
ai.org.providers.notAllowed: The server does not allow organizations a provider of their own; existing ones are not used.
ai.org.limits.title: Limits of the organization
ai.org.limits.lead: A value of its own applies only where it is lower than the server’s.
ai.org.limits.invalid: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
ai.org.sources.title: What AI may read
ai.org.sources.lead: Default: nothing. Only data sources opened to AI reach it, always with the rights of the person asking.
ai.org.sources.none: This organization has no data sources yet.
ai.org.sources.closed: AI does not see this source
ai.source.title: AI
ai.source.lead: Whether AI may read this data source, and what it never receives.
ai.source.readOnly: Only those who may edit this data source can open it to AI.
ai.source.readableText: Default: off. Without it, AI does not see this source: no explaining or drafting with its schema, no summaries of its panels.
ai.source.leavesText: tables, fields and types; the query text; for summaries the results, cut to the row limit.
ai.source.outwardText: For HTTP JSON and plugin sources, the query decides where a request goes and what it carries. A query the AI writes could carry data from the chat outward. Ask therefore runs only the stored queries of panels on it.
ai.source.rowLimit: At most {rows} rows, documents or nodes per result (the server’s limit).
ai.source.excludedHint: Names or dotted paths, at most {max}. The server replaces their values before sending; the model sees only the name. This works by name: a renamed or computed field is not covered, and values that serve as the id of a node or an edge or as a document’s _id stay. In “Ask”, a query or a panel that names an excluded field is not run; this too is best effort, not a barrier. Data that must never reach a provider belongs in a source closed to AI.
ai.source.fieldInvalid: Enter a name or dotted path of at most {max} characters, without empty parts.
ai.reason.ai.query_empty: There is no query to explain or summarize.
ai.reason.ai.query_too_large: The query is larger than {bytes} bytes.
ai.reason.ai.request_invalid: Describe what the query should return in 1 to {max} characters.
ai.call.slow: This takes longer than usual; the provider may be busy.
ai.call.draftUnfit: The answer is not a query of this data source; copy what helps by hand.
ai.call.draftNotRun: Not run yet. Apply replaces the query; undo with Ctrl+Z. Running it checks it like every query: read only.
ai.call.sentSchema: Sent: the query and the schema of the source.
ai.call.sentQueryOnly: Sent: only the query text; AI may not read this source, so no schema went along.
ai.call.sentSummaryTitled: Sent: title, query {queries} and {rows} rows to {provider} ({host}).
ai.call.sentTruncated: The result was cut to the row limit; the summary says so.
ai.call.sentExcluded: {count} values of excluded fields were left out.
ai.call.limitHint: An admin can raise your limit.
ai.call.closedHint: Whoever may edit the data source can open it to AI under Data source > AI.
ai.notice.title: Before you use AI
ai.notice.sends.explain: For “Explain”, the query text goes to {provider} ({host}), with the schema of the source only if the source is open to AI.
ai.notice.sends.draft: For “Draft”, your description and the query in the editor go to {provider} ({host}), with the schema of the source only if the source is open to AI.
ai.notice.sends.summarize: For “Summarize”, the title, the queries and up to {rows} rows of the result go to {provider} ({host}), only from sources open to AI.
ai.notice.mayBeWrong: Answers can be wrong; check them against the data.
ai.notice.neverText: Passwords, connection settings, keys, values of excluded fields, sources not open to AI and data you may not see yourself.
ai.notice.auditText: Every AI call is logged with person, time, provider and tokens, without questions, answers or results. For “Ask”, the text of every query the assistant runs is logged too; it stays as long as the audit log, also after the chat is deleted.
ai.notice.once: Shown once per person and provider.
ai.reason.ai.chat_busy: This chat is answering a question already. Wait until the answer is complete.
ai.reason.ai.chat_sources_invalid: Choose at most {max} sources for a chat.
ai.reason.ai.chat_source_not_selected: This source is not chosen for the chat.
ai.reason.ai.chat_tool_unknown: The assistant called a tool that does not exist: {name}
ai.reason.ai.chat_tool_arguments: The assistant called a tool with missing or malformed arguments.
ai.reason.ai.chat_tool_limit: This answer used its {max} tool calls.
ai.notice.sends.chat: For “Ask”, your questions, the schema of the sources open to AI and up to {rows} rows of each query the assistant runs with your rights go to {provider} ({host}).
ai.chat.title: Ask
ai.chat.empty.title: Ask your data
ai.chat.empty.text: Ask a question in plain words. The assistant reads the schema and data of the sources open to AI with your rights and shows every query it runs.
ai.chat.stopped: Stopped. What arrived until then is kept.
ai.chat.toolLimit: This answer reached its limit of tool calls.
ai.chat.truncated: Cut: the first {rows} rows went to the model.
ai.chat.withheld: No longer available: you lost access, or the source is no longer open to AI.
ai.chat.answerWithheld: Answer withheld because access to its data changed. The remaining results are shown as the rules apply now.
ai.chat.result.caption: Result {ref}
ai.chat.proposalHint: Not run. In Explore you check it and save it as a panel.
ai.chat.question: Question about your data
ai.chat.placeholder: Ask your data, for example: Which products were returned most often in October?
ai.chat.enterHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line
ai.chat.modelSetBy: Administrators choose model and provider under
ai.chat.orgModelSetBy: Your organization’s provider is set under
ai.chat.serverModelOwnAllowed: Server administrators choose model and provider. You can add a provider of your own under
ai.chat.serverModelOnly: Server administrators choose model and provider.
ai.chat.noSources: You may not read any data source. Ask about the panels of your dashboards.
ai.chat.rightsText: The assistant runs only read-only queries you could run yourself. The server refuses writing queries. Every query is in the audit log.
ai.chat.suggestion.sources: Which data sources can I ask, and what is in them?
ai.chat.suggestion.panels: What do the panels of my dashboards show right now?
ai.chat.suggestion.week: What changed in the last 7 days?
ai.chat.historyLead: Visible to you only. Chats are deleted {days} days after their last message.
ai.chat.historyLeadNone: Visible to you only. Chats are not kept.
ai.chat.confirmDelete.title: Delete the chat?
ai.chat.confirmDelete.text: “{title}” is deleted. This cannot be undone.
ai.chat.confirmDeleteMany.title: Delete {count} chats?
ai.chat.confirmDeleteAll.title: Delete all chats?
ai.chat.confirmDeleteMany.text: The chats are deleted. This cannot be undone.
ai.reason.ai.query_names_excluded_field: The query names “{field}”, a field excluded from AI. It is not run, since another name could pass its values on.
ai.reason.ai.outward_source_free_query: “{name}” sends requests outward. In Ask, only the stored queries of panels run on it, never queries the AI writes.
ai.reason.ai.outward_source_time_range: This panel reads a source that sends requests outward. Its time range then takes only a preset from 5 minutes to 1 year, or the dashboard’s saved range.
ai.reason.ai.panel_step_reads_excluded_f: A step of this panel reads “{field}”, a field excluded from AI. The panel is not run for AI, since the step could pass its values on under another name.
ai.admin.functions.title: Which provider for what
ai.admin.functions.lead: Applies to every organization without a provider of its own. Each provider asks for the notice once at its first call.
ai.reason.ai.provider_unknown: Choose one of the server’s providers or the default.
ai.chat.read.label: Label “{name}”
ai.chat.followUpExplore: Tell me more about the result from {name}.
ai.chat.followUpPanel: Tell me more about the panel “{title}”.
ai.chat.result.noSeries: Too few points in time for a time series.
ai.chat.leavesEstimateNo: By its address in the own network; a gateway there may forward
ai.admin.dialog.leavesNetworkHint: When the model runs outside your network, data leaves it, also through a gateway in your own network. Automatic estimates it from the address.
